name: Penalty Net Movement Record 1
definition: Specifies the attributes when the penalty applies to a net settlement movement.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

SecuritiesShortfall.name: Securities Shortfall
SecuritiesShortfall.definition: Total quantity of securities which failed to settle.

ShortfallValuation.name: Shortfall Valuation
ShortfallValuation.definition: Valuation of securities which failed to settle.

TradeTransactionCondition.name: Trade Transaction Condition
TradeTransactionCondition.definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

NumberOfEntries.name: Number Of Entries
NumberOfEntries.definition: Number of entries related to the net position.
